question: The monthly incomes of A and B are in the ratio 4 : 5, and their monthly expenditures are in the ratio 3 : 4. A saves ₹10,000 while B saves ₹12,000, find the monthly income of A (in ₹)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income = 4x, 5x and Expenditure = 3y, 4y

Savings: 4x − 3y = 10000 and 5x − 4y = 12000

Multiply: (1)×4 ⇒ 16x − 12y = 40000, (2)×3 ⇒ 15x − 12y = 36000

Subtract ⇒ x = 4000

Income of A = 4x = 16000

**∴ Answer = 16000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio A:B = 4 : 5

Expenditure ratio A:B = 3 : 4

Savings of A = 10000, B = 12000

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

 A: 4x − 3y B: 5x − 4y = 10000 = 12000 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4x − 3y = 10000 ...(1)

⇒ 5x − 4y = 12000 ...(2)

⇒ Multiply (1) by 4: 16x − 12y = 40000

⇒ Multiply (2) by 3: 15x − 12y = 36000

⇒ Subtract ⇒ x = 4000

⇒ Income of A = 4x = 16000

**∴ The correct answer is 16000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Savings Formula

Savings = Income − Expenditure
